description: A community gardener with one rare heirloom tomato seedling must decide whether to accept a neighbor's barter proposal, while comparing another interested gardener's offer and confirming the seedling's care requirements.

agents.name: Mina
agents.role: Gardener Who Knows of Another Offer

shared_context.S1: Ruth has one extra Brandywine tomato seedling from a small batch she started indoors.
shared_context.S2: Ruth decides whether to make a deal and sets the final exchange and handoff terms.
shared_context.S3: Cal has expressed interest in the seedling, and other gardeners may also be interested.
shared_context.S4: The community garden's usual exchange meeting begins with each attendee stating any concrete proposal and any practical care concern before an owner commits.

PF1.text: Cal's exact proposal is six hours of fence repair for Ruth, three bags of finished compost, and pickup of the seedling on Sunday at 09:00; Cal has not stated these complete terms to Ruth yet.

PF2.text: Mina was offered exactly $75 by another gardener, Priya, for the same seedling with pickup on Friday; Mina learned this directly from Priya and has not shared it with Ruth.

PF3.text: Owen inspected this seedling's parent plant and knows it must be kept under shade cloth for its first ten days after handoff because it was raised under low indoor light; he has not yet told Ruth this care requirement.

acceptance_conditions: The deal must be accepted with Cal as the selected partner.
The exchange must include exactly six hours of fence repair and exactly three bags of finished compost.
Pickup must be set for Sunday at 09:00.
The comparison offer must be recorded as exactly $75.
The seedling must be kept under shade cloth for exactly ten days after handoff.
A fence-repair commitment targeting Ruth must be logged.
A pickup commitment targeting Ruth must be logged.
A care-plan commitment for shade cloth must be logged.
The final justification must cite the exact barter proposal, competing offer, and care requirement after those facts are spoken aloud.

content_checks.C1: decisions['deal_accepted'] == True and decisions['selected_partner'] == 'Cal' and decisions['fence_repair_hours'] == 6 and decisions['compost_bags'] == 3 and decisions['pickup_day'] == 'Sunday' and decisions['pickup_time'] in ['09:00', '9:00 AM']
content_checks.C2: any(c['type'] == 'fence_repair' and c['target'] == 'Ruth' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C3: any(c['type'] == 'pickup' and c['target'] == 'Ruth' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'care_requirement' and c['target'] == 'Cal' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Cal's unrevealed proposal changes the selected partner to Cal, sets the exchange at exactly six fence-repair hours and three compost bags, fixes pickup for Sunday at 09:00, and supplies the terms for the required repair and pickup commitments.
Mina's competing offer changes the comparison field from an unknown value to exactly $75, giving Ruth the concrete benchmark for evaluating the barter.
Owen's care information changes the post-handoff plan from ordinary planting to exactly ten days under shade cloth and creates the required care commitment.
